evidence.result: the live console is now a declared service with ordering, dependencies, restart policy and jail scoping instead of a comment in init.sh

evidence.what: verify-service-graph.py grew section 3c (console single-owner assertions + lock-protocol cross-check) and PROVISIONED_NOT_ENABLED (an enablement exception that is asserted, not assumed)
evidence.result: carried in the report as provisioned_not_enabled + an INFO line

evidence.what: both VM/desktop USER units (nuxel-home-kiosk.service, nuxel-home-native.service) declared Wants=nuxel-web.service - a SYSTEM unit. In the user manager that name is a user unit that does not exist, so the dependency was unsatisfiable and implied an ordering that never happened
evidence.result: the dependency is removed and the real readiness owner is documented (the kiosk launcher polls http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html; the native launcher's sleep is labelled a timing wait). The validator grew USER_UNIT_SOURCES + section 3d, and the mutation test now fails if a user unit references a system unit or is enabled into a system target
units=15 problems=0 warnings=4 verdict=OFFLINE_TESTED (warnings: the VM-only camera portal plus the three user units' VM/desktop ExecStart paths - reported, never suppressed)

evidence.what: shell/config/systemd-user/{nuxel-home-kiosk,nuxel-home-native,nuxel-phosh-agent}.service documented as VM/desktop user units (including the honest consequence that the portal consent dialog has no surface on the handset in this revision)
evidence.result: the handset/VM boundary is explicit; the builder is forbidden from installing them

services/nuxel-console/test-console-ownership.py: PASS (unit semantics + builder rule + guard behaviour)
revisions.rollback: git revert the commit(s) touching this task's expected files; the change is repository-only and alters no device state
revisions.owner_action: No owner action for the graph itself. The live console unit is IMPLEMENTED_NOT_DEPLOYED as a systemd service: enabling it on the handset would require the console binary in the rootfs (the shipped image runs it from the initramfs) and stopping the initramfs instance first - a live change that has not been made. Live per-unit state (systemctl --failed) is bg-10's capture. The portal consent dialog has no session-bus agent on the handset (recorded gap for Priority 5).
revisions.note: Revision 2 (cycle 6): the one service briq-04b names that had no unit anywhere - the live console - is now declared, guarded and offline-tested; the installed-but-not-enabled state is asserted by the validator so it cannot silently become two console owners. Verdict OFFLINE_TESTED.
